text: LoongPort 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 Cordis 插件，用于接入经过签名目录验证的 OpenAI 兼容模型服务。它在设置页提供服务目录、模型和 API Key 管理，也会展示可用的 VeriDrop 服务状态信息；另含命令行设置入口，可配置自定义兼容服务商。适合希望在 DSH 中选择目录服务、保存凭据或添加自有模型端点的用户。设置页路径使用 DSH 凭据和设置服务；自定义端点流程需要用户提供服务 URL、模型名及 LOONGPORT_API_KEY。

LoongPort connects DSH web users to providers from a signed directory. Its settings page lists providers and models, shows service observations, and manages API keys. A setup CLI configures custom compatible endpoints. Users need a base URL, model ID, and API key for that CLI.

LoongPort 的功能「服务目录浏览」：设置页加载经过签名验证的服务目录，并显示服务商、模型及可选的状态观察信息。
LoongPort 的功能「服务商配置」：选择目录中的服务商后，将其模型和 API 地址写入 DSH 的模型提供商设置。
LoongPort 的功能「API Key 管理」：设置页可保存、查看是否已配置或清除所选服务商的 API Key。
LoongPort 的功能「Custom endpoint setup」：The CLI can add a compatible provider and its credential to DSH configuration.
LoongPort 的设置页从 config.loongport.dev 获取签名目录和状态观察数据；配置模型时会将 API 地址写入 DSH 设置。
LoongPort 的自定义端点 CLI 仅在提供 --write 时改写 DSH 配置，并把凭据写入 .credentials.yaml。

loongport README · loongport：`loongport` is a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
(DSH) Cordis bundle for verified LoongPort OpenAI-compatible providers. It also includes an
advanced CLI for custom endpoints.

loongport README · Install in DeepSeek Harness：Install the public package into the DSH profile you use:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add loongport
```

Open **Settings → LoongPort** in DSH, then:

loongport README · Install in DeepSeek Harness：1. Select a verified provider. The default is DeepSeek's official API at
   `https://api.deepseek.com/v1`; BestAPI (`https://api.bestapi.store/v1`) is the
   verified relay option.
2. If you need an account, use the provider's **Register** or **Sign in** link. It opens the
   provider's own website in your browser.
3. Generate an API key with the provider and paste it into the dialog.
4. Select `deepseek-v4-flash` or `deepseek-v4-pro`, then save.

loongport README · Install in DeepSeek Harness：The signed LoongPort directory is the authority for provider identity, URLs, available models,
and any published invitation code. VeriDrop data, when shown, is only a display-only health
observation and cannot change provider configuration. DSH credentials store API keys; the
Settings page only retains whether a key is configured.

loongport README · Install in DeepSeek Harness：Version 0.2.0 does not automate browser authorization, collect browser sessions, or access
cookies/local storage. Registration/login and API-key creation remain on the provider's site.

loongport README · Advanced custom endpoint：For a manually supplied OpenAI-compatible endpoint, run the CLI directly:

```bash
LOONGPORT_API_KEY='your-api-key' npx loongport dsh setup \
  --base-url https://relay.example.com/v1 \
  --model model-id \
  --write

The API key is read only from `LOONGPORT_API_KEY`; never place it in a command argument. You
can repeat `--model` to register more than one model.

loongport README · Advanced custom endpoint：By default, the command performs a dry run. Add `--write` to update DSH's
configuration. It uses `$DSH_HOME` when set, otherwise `~/.dsh`, and writes:

- `settings.yaml`: one selected `llm-pi-ai.providers.<route>` entry
- `.credentials.yaml`: the selected credential name and API key (owner-only)

Other DSH settings, provider routes, and credentials are preserved. The
command uses DSH's built-in `llm-pi-ai` transport; it does not implement its
own streaming, retries, or tool calls.

loongport README · Options：```text
--base-url <url>              OpenAI-compatible HTTP(S) endpoint (required)
--model <id>                  Model to expose; repeat for multiple models (required)
--route <name>                DSH provider route (default: loongport)
--credential-name <name>      DSH credential key (default: LOONGPORT_API_KEY)

loongport README · Options：The CLI remains an explicit advanced path. It supports manually provisioned
OpenAI-compatible endpoints, but does not automate third-party browser login, relay discovery,
desktop-app bridging, or automatic tier switching.

loongport README · Maintainers：Agents and maintainers should read the [agent guide](docs/maintainers/agent-guide.md)
before changing the package and follow the [release runbook](docs/maintainers/releasing.md)
before publishing.
